name: P0 refit-cadence parity (production daily full refit vs validated 126-session research cadence)
status: FROZEN before any P0 result was observed
purpose: Methodology diagnostic: does denser full refitting of the SAME fixed seeds change OOS ranking quality, portfolio outcome, turnover or prediction stability? Cadence is the ONLY experimental variable.

evaluation_interval.note: Latest half-year inside the frozen champion window (panel freeze 2026-07-23). This interval has ALREADY influenced research selection; it is NOT an untouched final test and results must not be described as OOS validation of the champion.
evaluation_interval.status: BURNED DIAGNOSTIC INTERVAL: already influenced research selection; NOT untouched final OOS, NOT final validation, NOT prospective confirmation; P0 results are parity diagnostics, never independent estimates of strategy performance

decision_dates: every trading date in research/data_cache between start and end inclusive (~137 sessions); identical for both arms; the exact list is written to p0/decision_dates.json by the runner before any fit

seeds.production_seed_policy: same fixed IDs retrained from scratch each session (verified: tests/test_seed_reproducibility.py)
seeds.rule: identical seed IDs in both arms of every comparison; 3-seed arms are never compared with the 7-seed champion panel

arms.cadence_definition: refit k trains on all matured labels with label_end <= (first decision date of block k) - 1 and scores every decision date of its block; 'daily' = block length 1

held_constant.features: close_only (10 per-stock trailing close-price features, clip +/-10, no scaler)
held_constant.architecture: LSTM_CondTransformer preset B: hidden 64, lstm_layers 1, trans_layers 2, heads 4, ff 128, dropout 0.2, seq_len 60
held_constant.early_stop: argmax val rank IC, patience 3, min_epochs 2, max_epochs 25
held_constant.validation_split: matured_train_val: newest 10% of matured dates as validation, train <= v0 - purge
held_constant.dataset_build: one build_dataset over the full cache; labels masked by maturity per refit (features are causal - tests/test_leakage_alignment.py); no future-trained weights reused
held_constant.execution_timing: label convention T+1 close -> T+21 close (next-open validated equivalent, v16)

metrics.paired: all IC/spread metrics computed per decision date and differenced (B - A) on the same dates; HAC (Bartlett, lag 20) standard error of the mean difference

decision_thresholds.derivation: from the champion's historical per-date IC std (~0.197 CH) and its book-level noise: dIC of 0.005 is ~7% of the mean CH IC and inside one HAC SE for a 137-date paired sample; 0.010 (~15%) with a consistent multi-metric direction is treated as material. Sharpe-like metrics over ~6 blocks are reported but are NOT decisive.
decision_thresholds.PARITY_OK: dIC_mean(B-A) >= -0.005 (or negative but within 1 HAC SE of 0) AND dPosFrac >= -0.05 AND consecutive-refit rank corr(B) >= 0.90 AND top-quintile overlap(B) >= 0.70 AND dTurnover <= +0.05 AND dMaxDD <= +3pp
decision_thresholds.PRODUCTION_RESEARCH_PARITY_RISK: dIC_mean(B-A) <= -0.010 AND dIC below -1 HAC SE AND at least two of: dPosFrac <= -0.05; dSpread20 <= -0.5pp; rank corr(B) < 0.80 or overlap(B) < 0.50; dTurnover > +0.10
decision_thresholds.PARITY_WARNING: anything else (material movement without consistent direction/evidence)
decision_thresholds.better_than_A: if B is materially better, record it; it does not change the champion references (they would be conservative)
decision_thresholds.note: thresholds fixed before the run; not to be tuned afterwards

compute.P0_A_prime_fits: arm A 2 refits x 3 seeds + arm B ceil(137/5)=28 refits x 3 seeds = 90 seed-fits ~= 1.75 h + ~1 min dataset build
compute.stop_rule: if the runner's printed estimate exceeds 2.5 h, STOP and report
compute.P0_A_fits: arm C: 131 daily refits x 3 seeds = 393 seed-fits (A/B reused from cache) ~= 5.8 h at the measured 52.7 s/fit (P0-A' average), 7.6 h at 70 s/fit; must not overlap the 22:00 daily_ops window (runner --deadline stops launching new fits; resumable)

artifacts.resume: existing fit keys are skipped; only missing fits are computed
artifacts.production_isolation: writes ONLY under the artifacts root; never touches checkpoints/, reports/transformer_gpu/, reports/paper_trading/, reports/user_actions/, my_holdings.csv, intraday SQLite, scheduled tasks

P0_A_daily_interpretation.P0_A_DAILY: the P0-A' decision_thresholds applied to the paired C-A comparison (daily minus 126-session) on identical dates; A/B fits reused from cache when config hashes match

REFIT_DENSITY_EFFECT.DENSITY_RELATED: C-A dIC <= (B-A dIC) - 0.005 AND C is worse than B on at least 4 of the 7 components (direction-aware) AND C-A is not PARITY_OK
REFIT_DENSITY_EFFECT.NON_MONOTONIC: B-A was outside PARITY_OK tolerances but C-A dIC >= (B-A dIC) + 0.005 (daily recovers) or C-A satisfies PARITY_OK while B-A did not
REFIT_DENSITY_EFFECT.INCONCLUSIVE: anything else (e.g. |C-A dIC - B-A dIC| < 0.005 with mixed component directions)
REFIT_DENSITY_EFFECT.note: perfect monotonicity is not required; Sharpe-like metrics are one component, never decisive alone

BAND10_ROBUSTNESS.basis: C-A on the blend50+band10 long-only book
BAND10_ROBUSTNESS.ABSORBS_DIFFERENCE: |d net100| <= 0.15 AND d max_dd <= +1.0pp (B worse) AND d turnover <= +0.05
BAND10_ROBUSTNESS.PARTIALLY_ABSORBS_DIFFERENCE: within 2x those tolerances (|d net100| <= 0.30, d max_dd <= +2.0pp, d turnover <= +0.10)

REFIT_SHOCK_DIAGNOSTIC.definition: at every refit boundary the PREVIOUS model scores the boundary date (its stored overlap prediction) and the NEW model scores the same date from IDENTICAL feature windows; metrics: score corr, rank Spearman, top-20% Jaccard, names entering/leaving top quintile, mean |rank move|, max |rank move|. This isolates refit shock from market evolution because both models see the same inputs on the same date.
REFIT_SHOCK_DIAGNOSTIC.feasibility: available without redesign: the runner already stores each fit's overlap-date prediction

P0_A_daily_interpretation.VAL_VS_OOS_DISSOCIATION: per refit: own validation IC (stored) vs the mean OOS rank IC over that refit's block dates; report per-arm means and the across-refit Spearman correlation; a positive val-IC gap with a negative OOS-IC gap between arms is recorded as a dissociation
P0_A_daily_interpretation.decision_rule_after_result: STOP in every case; P0-B is never auto-launched
